_notes: Tutorial script, steps, Lieutenant mentor dialogues, and science glossary for LunArk: Genesis.

dialogue: Welcome to the Moon, Commander!
I am Lieutenant Vance. Let us set up your mission.

steps.title: Five Base Indicators
dialogue: These five bars track base health.
Energy powers rooms. Science unlocks tech.
Boredom tracks crew mood. Revenue is your funds.
The Event bar warns of incoming danger.

steps.title: The Habitat Pod
dialogue: This is our Habitat Pod.
Our astronauts live here.
They need electricity, good food, and fun!

steps.title: Build a Fuel Cell
dialogue: We need electricity right away.
Open Generator in your Build Tray.
Place a Fuel Cell on the lunar ground!

steps.title: Build a Datacentre
dialogue: Expanding our base costs money.
Select Cashflow in the Build Tray.
Place a Datacentre to earn Revenue each second.

steps.title: Lunar Day and Night
dialogue: Watch the day and night clock.
The Sun shines for 180 seconds, then darkness falls.
Solar stops at night, and heaters use extra power.

steps.title: The Mission Goal
dialogue: Your goal is to build Planet Stats and survive 3 cycles.
Research tech and keep your crew happy.
Good luck, Commander! You are ready to lead.
Outstanding preparation, Commander!
You have earned the LunArk Cadet Wings badge.
Base control is now in your hands. Good luck!

glossary.definition: A rare gas on the Moon used for clean nuclear fusion.
Fine lunar soil that shields buildings from deadly space radiation.
A powerful burst of high-energy radiation released by the Sun.
A tiny space rock travelling faster than a bullet.
A clean generator joining hydrogen and oxygen into electricity and water.
A fission power station providing massive, continuous electricity day and night.
A freezing two-week dark period on the Moon without sunlight.
Special panels that convert natural sunlight directly into electrical power.
